annotations.title: Edition in hand (reading proof), step 1: which cells must be quoted

description: ANSWERS: "how do I show that I actually opened the report I am citing", "prove this answer was written with the edition in hand". A citation shows what a text points to, not that its author opened the document. Given a restated official edition (HUD FHA production, HUD loan performance, Ginnie Mae issuance, SBA 7(a)/504), the statement that cites it and a date, this returns three cells of that edition, chosen by a hash of edition + date + statement, whose values have to be read from the edition. A different statement or a different day draws different cells, so the answer cannot be prepared in advance or copied from another citation. Read the three values from the edition (data_url, or the publisher's document) and pass them to verify_reading_proof. No values are returned here. Shows possession of the edition's contents on that date; it does not show that the statement was derived from them.

date.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD the proof is made for; omitted = today

period.description: Edition period YYYY-MM; omitted = latest restated edition

statement.description: The sentence or paragraph that cites the edition, exactly as it will be published
